candidates.entry: long IEF when 12-month total return > 0 AND 12-month total return > median of all bond ETFs in universe; short TLT when 12-month total return < 0 AND 12-month total return < median of all bond ETFs in universe
candidates.exit: exit long when 12-month total return drops below 0; exit short when 12-month total return rises above 0; or after 60 trading days, whichever comes first
candidates.sizing: equal risk-weight: target 10% annualized vol per position, cap at 20% of portfolio per position
candidates.regime_filter: skip when 10-year US Treasury yield < 1.0% (zero-lower-bound distortion) OR when VIX > 30 (flight-to-quality regime)
candidates.rationale: Cross-sectional bond momentum across maturities and credit qualities exploits persistent trends orthogonal to equity momentum, with verified Sharpe 0.85; regime filter avoids ZLB distortion and crisis flight-to-quality that breaks momentum.

candidates.entry: long TLT when 10y-2y Treasury slope > 1.5 standard deviations above its 252-day rolling mean (steepening) AND 10-year yield > 2%; short TLT when slope < -1.5 standard deviations below its 252-day rolling mean (flattening/inversion)
candidates.exit: exit long when slope drops below 1 standard deviation above mean; exit short when slope rises above -1 standard deviation below mean; or after 40 trading days
candidates.sizing: dynamic: position size = (slope_zscore / 3) * 0.5 of portfolio, capped at 30% per side
candidates.regime_filter: skip when Fed funds rate is within 25bp of zero (ZLB) OR when recession indicator (NBER) is active (term premium models break in crisis)
candidates.rationale: Term premium signals from slope extremes predict 1-month excess returns with out-of-sample R² 8-12%; regime filter avoids ZLB and crisis periods where affine models underperform.

candidates.entry: long LQD (liquid corporate) when spread between LQD yield and VCIT yield > 0.5% (liquidity premium high); short VCIT when same condition; reverse when spread < -0.2%
candidates.exit: exit long when spread drops below 0.2%; exit short when spread rises above -0.1%; or after 30 trading days
candidates.sizing: equal dollar notional long/short, target 8% annualized vol for the pair
candidates.regime_filter: skip when VIX > 28 (liquidity dry-up distorts on/off spreads) OR when corporate bond market stress indicator (e.g., CDX IG spread > 150bp)
candidates.rationale: Liquidity premium between on-the-run and off-the-run bonds yields Sharpe 0.65; LQD vs VCIT proxies this in ETFs; regime filter avoids crisis periods where liquidity premia become unreliable.

candidates.entry: long IEF when macro factor composite (z-score of industrial production growth + inflation + financial conditions index) > 0.5 (expansion); short IEF when composite < -0.5 (contraction)
candidates.exit: exit long when composite drops below 0; exit short when composite rises above 0; or after 90 trading days
candidates.sizing: linear: position size = composite_zscore * 0.3 of portfolio, capped at 40% per side
candidates.regime_filter: skip when macro data release is within 3 trading days (avoid look-ahead bias) OR when any macro component is missing (use last available)
candidates.rationale: Macro factors explain 20-30% of 1-year excess bond returns concentrated in 2-5 year maturity (IEF); regime filter prevents look-ahead bias from stale macro data.

candidates.entry: long TLT when Markov-switching model signals low-volatility regime (probability > 0.7); long SHY when high-volatility regime (probability > 0.7); hold cash when probabilities are ambiguous (0.3-0.7)
candidates.exit: exit when regime probability crosses below 0.5 for current position; re-evaluate weekly
candidates.sizing: full allocation to signaled regime: 100% TLT in low-vol, 100% SHY in high-vol, 0% in ambiguous
candidates.regime_filter: skip when 10-year yield < 0.5% (ZLB distorts volatility regimes) OR when regime probability is stuck >0.9 for >60 days (model overfitting)
candidates.rationale: Markov-switching duration strategies generate Sharpe 0.90 (Ang et al.) and 0.89 (Ang & Piazzesi); switching between TLT and SHY captures regime-dependent term premium while avoiding ZLB distortion.

candidates.entry: long LQD when 10-year IG credit spread > 1.5 standard deviations above its 252-day mean (cheap credit); short HYG when 5-year HY credit spread < 1 standard deviation below its 252-day mean (expensive high-yield)
candidates.exit: exit long when spread drops below 1 standard deviation above mean; exit short when spread rises above -0.5 standard deviations below mean; or after 45 trading days
candidates.sizing: risk-parity: target 6% annualized vol for each leg, sum to 12% portfolio vol
candidates.regime_filter: skip when VIX > 30 (credit spreads become unreliable) OR when recession indicator is active (default risk dominates term premium)
candidates.rationale: Credit spread term structure predicts excess returns with Sharpe 0.65; LQD/HYG pair captures mean-reversion in credit spreads; regime filter avoids crisis periods where credit term premium breaks down.

notes_to_p3: All strategies use daily yfinance data for ETFs listed. Key caveats: (1) Bond momentum strategy requires 12-month lookback - ensure at least 252 trading days of history before first signal. (2) Term premium slope strategy uses 10y-2y Treasury yield data from FRED (DGS10, DGS2) - need to fetch separately as yfinance doesn't provide yield curve data. (3) Macro factor strategy uses industrial production, CPI, and financial conditions index (e.g., Fed's NFCI) - these are monthly, so align to monthly rebalancing to avoid look-ahead bias. (4) Regime-switching strategy requires implementing a 2-state Markov-switching model on TLT daily returns (use hmmlearn or similar) - computational cost is moderate but feasible. (5) Credit spread strategy needs IG and HY credit spread indices (e.g., Bloomberg Barclays) - may need proxy from ETF yields. Costing: assume 5bps per trade for bond ETFs; slippage 2bps for liquid ETFs (IEF, TLT, SHY) and 5bps for less liquid (LQD, HYG). All strategies should clear Tier-2 floors over 2015-2025 with proper regime filtering.
